microcycles.name: Break-In Week 1: Block 1 Microcycle 1
microcycles.description: Perform these exercises at an RIR of approximately 4.

microcycles.name: Break-In Week 2: Block 1 Microcycle 2
microcycles.description: Perform these exercises at an RIR of 3.

microcycles.name: Break-In Week 3: Block 1 Microcycle 3
microcycles.description: Perform these exercises at an RIR of 1 or 2.

microcycles.name: Break-In Week 4: Block 1 Microcycle 4
microcycles.description: Perform these exercises at an RIR of approximately 4. Rest approximately two minutes between sets.

microcycles.name: Break-In Week 5: Block 2 Microcycle 1
microcycles.description: Perform the first set of exercises at an RIR of about 3, perform the second set at an RIR of about 1 or 2, and take the final set to the point of concentric muscle failure. Rest 30 seconds between sets.

microcycles.name: Break-In Week 6: Block 2 Microcycle 2
microcycles.description: Perform the first set of exercises at an RIR of about 3, perform the second set at an RIR of about 1 or 2, and take the final set to the point of concentric muscle failure. Rest approximately two minutes between sets.

microcycles.name: Break-In Week 7: Block 2 Microcycle 3
microcycles.description: Perform the first set at an RIR of about 3, perform the second set at an RIR of about 2, and perform the final set at an RIR of about 1. Rest approximately three minutes between sets.

microcycles.name: Break-In Week 8: Block 2 Microcycle 4
microcycles.description: Perform these exercises at an RIR of approximately 4. Rest approximately two minutes between sets.

microcycles.name: Strength Phase Week 1: Block 1 Microcycle 1
microcycles.description: Perform these exercises at an RIR of 2 or 3.

microcycles.name: Strength Phase Week 2: Block 1 Microcycle 2
microcycles.description: Perform these exercises at an RIR of 1 or 2.

microcycles.name: Strength Phase Week 3: Block 1 Microcycle 3
microcycles.description: Perform the first set of exercises at an RIR of 2, perform the second set at an RIR of 1, and take the final maximal set to the point of concentric muscle failure or just short of failure (RIR of 0.5).

microcycles.name: Strength Phase Week 4: Block 1 Microcycle 4
microcycles.description: Perform these exercises at an RIR of about 4.

microcycles.name: Strength Phase Week 5: Block 2 Microcycle 1
microcycles.description: Perform these exercises at an RIR of 2 or 3.

microcycles.name: Strength Phase Week 6: Block 2 Microcycle 2
microcycles.description: Perform these exercises at an RIR of 1 or 2.

microcycles.name: Strength Phase Week 7: Block 2 Microcycle 3
microcycles.description: On the primary exercises, the first set should be performed at an RIR of 2, the second set should be performed at an RIR of 1, and the final set should be taken to the point of concentric muscle failure or just short of failure (RIR of 0.5). Assistance exercises should be performed at an RIR of approximately 1 or 2.

microcycles.name: Strength Phase Week 8: Block 2 Microcycle 4
microcycles.description: Perform these exercises at an RIR of about 4.
